notebooks.title: 复算横向模型、响应与附着边界
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import expm
def matrices(u):
    if u <= 0:
        raise ValueError("positive longitudinal speed required")
    m, Iz, a, b, Cf, Cr = 1600.0, 2500.0, 1.4, 1.4, 80000.0, 80000.0
    A = np.array([[-(Cf+Cr)/(m*u), -u-(a*Cf-b*Cr)/(m*u)],
                  [-(a*Cf-b*Cr)/(Iz*u), -(a*a*Cf+b*b*Cr)/(Iz*u)]])
    B = np.array([Cf/m, a*Cf/Iz])
    return A, B

cells.code:
A, B = matrices(10)
delta = 0.04
steady = np.linalg.solve(A, -B*delta)
M = np.zeros((3,3)); M[:2,:2] = A; M[:2,2] = B*delta
last = (expm(M*2) @ np.array([0.,0.,1.]))[:2]
print("A", A.tolist(), "B", B.tolist())
print("eigenvalues", np.linalg.eigvals(A).tolist())
print("initial_derivative", (B*delta).tolist())
print("steady_vy_r", steady.tolist(), "sample_2s", last.tolist())
alpha = [delta-(steady[0]+1.4*steady[1])/10, -(steady[0]-1.4*steady[1])/10]
print("steady_front_rear_slip", alpha)
print("steady_ay", 10*steady[1])
